title: Jazz Jam @ Hay Camp Brewing Co.
event_description: Monthly all-ages jazz jam session featuring a house band that sets the mood followed by an open jam where local musicians of all skill levels can sit in and showcase their talents. A welcoming atmosphere for players listeners and jazz enthusiasts alike.
venue_address: 601 Kansas City St Rapid City SD 57701
event_venue_information:
About Hay Camp Brewing Co.

Operating under the original name given to Rapid City in 1876 Hay Camp this brewery combines craft beer with community events. Founded in 2013 as Rapid City's first production brewery the venue features authentic Black Hills history with repurposed woodwork from the Homestake Mine throughout the space.

The Venue Space

Hay Camp features three distinct areas: The Tavern (main gathering space) The Commons (home to the Bashful Bison deli with locally sourced food) and The Event Space (hosting up to 250 people for concerts weddings and celebrations). The brewery serves small-batch handcrafted ales brewed on-site with a rotating selection of styles from crisp lagers to barrel-aged imperial stouts.

Music & Events

Beyond the monthly jazz jam Hay Camp hosts trivia Thursdays from 6-8 PM karaoke Wednesdays from 6-9 PM and free pinball Fridays from 4-6 PM. The venue regularly features regional and national touring musicians several times per month and hosts loading dock concerts during summer months. Live music is typically scheduled Thursday through Saturday nights.

title: Emerging Performing Artists Open Mic @ Main Street Square
event_description: Monthly open mic event featuring local musicians and performing artists in downtown Rapid City's premier outdoor public space. A free community event where performers can sign up to showcase original songs covers poetry and performances.
event_venue_information:
About Main Street Square

Located in the heart of Downtown Rapid City Main Street Square is a fun-filled public space managed by a nonprofit organization. The square features special events arts and culture live concerts seasonal ice skating and interactive fountains. Surrounded by the City of Presidents boutiques eateries and galleries Main Street Square serves as a destination for the entire community.

The Square

This outdoor venue provides a beautiful open-air space with modern sound systems and stage lighting. The square hosts free concerts throughout the year with the Emerging Performing Artists series being a highlight of the First Friday Art Walk events. The venue is accessible to all individuals with ADA compliant amenities.

Events & Programming

Main Street Square coordinates with the Rapid City Arts Council to present monthly open mic opportunities as part of the downtown Art Walk series. The square also hosts seasonal concerts family events and cultural celebrations. Street performers must contact Main Street Square office for permission to perform at signature events.

title: Open Mic Night @ Aby's Rapid City
event_description: Weekly open mic night featuring live music poetry and performance in a historic grain mill turned contemporary venue. Musicians and performers of all levels welcome to showcase their talents in an intimate setting with a supportive local crowd.
event_venue_information:
About Aby's Rapid City

Dating back to the early 1900s this family-owned grain mill has been transformed into Rapid City's premier live music venue beer bar and wine bar. The beautifully designed space showcases the building's historic architecture while creating an inviting atmosphere for music art and community gathering.

The Venue

Aby's features both indoor and outdoor spaces with 12 beer taps highlighting local craft breweries a curated wine selection and a rotating art gallery. The venue hosts a weekly Jazz Brunch on Sundays featuring local jazz artists and breakfast foods. Open Wednesday through Saturday evenings the space welcomes a diverse crowd for music trivia bingo and special events.

Music Programming

Beyond open mic Wednesdays Aby's hosts live music Thursday through Saturday nights featuring local and regional bands. The venue has become a central hub for entertainment in downtown Rapid City with regular concerts DJ performances and poetry nights. Recent partnerships with Elevate Rapid City and the Downtown Innovation District have positioned Aby's as a key cultural venue in the city's music scene.
